Interesting! There's another payment for "Diya Kapoor" but that's different from "Aryan Kapoor" and has a different order receipt.

Now, the key insight here is that while the accepted explanation matches INV-00171 to Aryan Kapoor (which makes logical sense), technically any of the 12 invoices with 3,200,000 paise could arithmetically match this payment. The original explanation is marked as "partial_payment" pattern, suggesting this is a partial payment toward an invoice.

However, I notice that the payment captured on 2026-09-06 could potentially match INV-00105 (issued 2026-09-07 to Vivaan Kulkarni, due 2026-09-22). But wait - that invoice is issued AFTER the payment was captured, so that doesn't make logical sense.
